**Möbius Energy of Thick Knots Eric J. Rawdon 2**

*Department of Mathematics and Computer Science*

16 pp, 19 sections.

**Abstract.** The M¨ obius energy of a knot is an energy functional for smoot h curves based on an idea of self-repelling. If a knot has a thick tubular neigh borhood, we would intuitively expect the energy to be low. In this paper, we giv e explicit bounds for energy in terms of the ropelength of the knot, i.e. the ratio o f the length of a thickest tube to its radius.
